Who we are

A trusted bridge between China and America

Sorghuman Holding LLC is a New York-registered importer and distributor specializing in authentic frozen Chinese food products. We work directly with established manufacturers in China to deliver high-quality, ready-to-cook products to retailers across the northeastern U.S.

我们致力于将来自中国的优质冷冻食品引入北美市场，让消费者在家就能品尝到地道的中国美食。
